prompt: Flat 2D cartoon illustration for a children's-book-style language course. Clean uniform dark-brown outlines, flat colours with at most one soft shadow tone, simple rounded shapes, simple friendly faces with small dot eyes, warm muted palette of cream, sage green, mustard, terracotta and dusty blue. Clean, readable composition with plenty of simple everyday details drawn as plain shapes, no textures. No text, no letters, no logos, no speech bubbles, no photorealism, no 3D rendering. Wide establishing shot of an empty location, no people, framed wide enough that every item in the description is visible and none is left out. A lively, narrow multicultural shopping street in Lombok, Utrecht, seen along its length at street level. Both sides: two- and three-storey brown and red-brick buildings with shops at street level: on the left a bakery with bread in the window and next to it a small supermarket with fruit and vegetable crates outside; on the right a pharmacy with a green cross, a bike shop with bikes outside, and a bus stop shelter opposite the supermarket. Shop fronts have plain coloured awnings and boards with simple pictograms only. Many bicycles parked against the walls, a few cyclists, narrow pavements, small street trees with yellow autumn leaves. At the far end of the street, rising above the roofs: a big white mosque with a dome and one tall slender minaret. Soft autumn sunlight, blue sky with a few clouds.
